name: Victoria Gardens
summary: Outdoor retail complex with popular brand-name stores, plus restaurants & a movie theater.
description: Victoria Gardens is an open-air lifestyle center in Rancho Cucamonga offering over 150 retailers and eateries alongside premier entertainment destinations including AMC Theatres, the Victoria Gardens Cultural Art Center, and the Rancho Cucamonga Public Library. Anchored by Macy's, JCPenney, and Bass Pro Shops, this vibrant shopping destination provides a comprehensive collection of shopping, dining, and cultural experiences in a walkable, outdoor environment.
demographics: Victoria Gardens serves the affluent Inland Empire market, attracting families and professionals from Rancho Cucamonga and surrounding communities in San Bernardino County. The trade area features middle to upper-middle income households with a median age range of 30-55, drawn to the center's mix of value-oriented anchors and specialty retailers. Visitors typically engage in multi-purpose trips combining shopping with dining and entertainment, reflecting the lifestyle center format that caters to family-oriented shoppers seeking convenience and experience beyond traditional mall offerings.
